current.text: He is not in the projected Philadelphia starting five. He said himself that the young guy should start over him.
Experts are not sure he has anything left.
Nick Nurse plays his starters very heavy minutes and the Philadelphia guard rotation is crowded. That leaves little room for a bench guard.
Philadelphia has 13 back-to-backs, and three of them fall in the fantasy playoffs.

tags.name: age decline watch
tags.detail: Expert unsure he has anything left; minutes fell in each of the last three seasons

tags.name: bad playoff schedule
tags.detail: Three Philadelphia back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs

note: Yahoo ranks him 248 and ESPN 246, both with a value of 0 USD, and our league did not draft him last season. That puts him well outside our 144 drafted players, so do not draft him. He has no category strong enough to carry a punt build: his FT% and low turnovers are mild pluses on very low volume, and he is behind the starters in a crowded Philadelphia rotation. Look at him only if a Philadelphia guard gets hurt and his minutes rise well above the 21.3 he played last season.
